description: Canonical corpus manifest defining explicit identity, byte hashes, migration hashes, and deterministic logical content hashes for Chat Engine V2

canonicalCorpus.primaryApprovedFile: rincian Biaya SI,TI dan BD Tahun Ajaran 2026-2027.pdf

hashDefinitions.historicalMigrationSha256: Raw byte SHA-256 of pre-migration canonical snapshot file (25,116,785 bytes) recorded in scratch/release_manifest.json and scripts/migrate_pgvector_chunks.js before embedding vectors were serialized into local snapshot file. Note: This is an input migration artifact hash, not an embedding vector hash.
hashDefinitions.diskSnapshotSha256: Raw byte SHA-256 of local snapshot file on disk data/runtime/index_snapshots/2026-08-11T04-14-17-889Z_before-final-knowledgeprep-deploy/rag_index.json (34,670,163 bytes) containing 829 records with 1536-dimension embedding arrays.
hashDefinitions.canonicalContentSha256: Deterministic SHA-256 logical content hash (Schema v2-canonical-json). Evaluated over all records sorted by id ascending (code-point order). Each record is normalized into a canonical JSON line with strictly sorted keys: academicLevel, campus, category, docCategory, id, program, programName, sourceFile, text. CRLF normalized to LF, strings trimmed, empty/absent values normalized to null. Records separated by newline (\n) and UTF-8 encoded. Invariant between PostgreSQL rows and disk snapshot. Immune to delimiter collisions and protects retrieval & scope metadata.
